tier_rationale: The selected reference MDP is synchronous by itself, but the requested harness must run it as a tier-2 game: an adaptor-owned worker advances one joint transition every 1/6 second while Astra reasons asynchronously and Jev chooses fast task continuations. Missing a primitive action deadline costs approximately one simulation tick of movement, cooking opportunity, or delivery throughput; the world must not wait for a model response. The official demo uses a 6-Hz tick loop, while the benchmark uses a 400-tick horizon. A synchronous debug mode is useful for replay but is not the tier-2 execution mode.

interface.why: HumanCompatibleAI/overcooked_ai is the reference open-source symbolic environment: it is local, CPU-capable, account-free, deterministic, exposes the complete OvercookedState and exact sparse reward, and has native MotionPlanner/GreedyHumanModel scripted-agent support. It is safer and more reliable than GUI capture, commercial-game modding, emulator hooks, or a network demo. The adaptor must add a nonblocking 6-Hz ticking worker because the native OvercookedEnv API advances only when step is called.
setup_steps: Use /home/hemlix/GamingMaster-mh-tier2/runs/overcooked/.venv/bin/python and its pip, not the system Python.
Install the pinned GitHub source with an explicit Python-compatibility override because upstream pyproject.toml currently declares >=3.10,<3.11 while the evaluator is Python 3.12.3.
Install the runtime dependencies: dill, gymnasium, ipywidgets, numpy<2, opencv-python-headless, pygame, scipy, setuptools>=77.0.3, and tqdm; do not install the optional HARL/Ray/TensorFlow extra.
Set SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy if any import path initializes pygame; do not create a display or call rendering in the headless adaptor.
Construct OvercookedGridworld.from_layout_name(layout_name, old_dynamics=False), then OvercookedEnv.from_mdp(mdp, horizon=400, info_level=0).
Precompute env.mlam and its MotionPlanner before starting the real-time clock, then construct a separate GreedyHumanModel(env.mlam) or a scenario-specific scripted Agent as partner.
At reset(seed, scenario), seed all adaptor-owned RNGs, choose the layout/start-state variant, reset env and agents, create a new episode ID, and publish tick-zero state.

Run an adaptor-owned worker at 6 ticks per second; each tick consumes the newest valid controlled action and partner action, substitutes STAY for a missing/stale action, calls env.step once, and publishes the serialized state.
Translate Gym integer action indices only at the boundary; native OvercookedEnv.step receives a pair of Action objects from Action.ALL_ACTIONS.
Serialize observations with state.to_dict() plus terrain_mtx, layout_name, score, events, tick, and deadlines; reject model replies from an old episode or stale tick.
Stop at done or timestep 400, report cumulative sparse reward and diagnostics, join workers, clear queues, and reset agents before the next episode.
Run a smoke test under the evaluator interpreter: construct cramped_room, step STAY four times, round-trip OvercookedState JSON, and obtain one valid action from the scripted partner.
interface.observation: Canonical observation is a JSON-safe snapshot containing episode_id, layout_name, terrain_mtx, horizon, state.to_dict(), cumulative sparse score, last sparse reward, sparse_r_by_agent, shaped_r_by_agent, event flags, partner's last action/task, controlled_agent_index, current tick, and wall-clock deadline. state.to_dict() contains players with (x,y) position, orientation, held object, unheld objects including soup ingredients/cooking tick/ready flags, bonus_orders, all_orders, and timestep. Include terrain_mtx because the state dictionary alone does not identify counters, dispensers, pots, or serving tiles. The environment also provides lossless_state_encoding_mdp(state) and featurize_state_mdp(state), but those tensors are optional policy inputs rather than the Astra/Jev canonical representation.
interface.actions: The adaptor controls one chef with one primitive per tick and supplies a joint action to OvercookedEnv.step((action0, action1)). Native actions are Direction.NORTH=(0,-1), SOUTH=(0,1), EAST=(1,0), WEST=(-1,0), Action.STAY=(0,0), and Action.INTERACT='interact'; Action.ALL_ACTIONS orders them as north, south, east, west, stay, interact. INTERACT operates the feature immediately ahead. The partner implements Agent.action(state) -> (action, info), normally via GreedyHumanModel(env.mlam) on standard three-onion layouts. Use MotionPlanner/MLAM to turn high-level tasks into safe primitive actions, replan after interactions/collisions, and validate all preconditions in code. A missing model reply becomes STAY rather than blocking the clock.

scoring: Report cumulative sparse team reward: sum of env.step's sparse_r_by_agent or env_info episode ep_sparse_r over the 400-tick episode. This counts only accepted soup deliveries and is the true benchmark objective; do not add shaped rewards. Also report deliveries, score by agent, episode length, event counts, collision/stuck ticks, pot idle time, and handoff failures as diagnostics. In this environment an ordinary accepted recipe is commonly worth 20, bonus orders use order_bonus*recipe.value, and layouts may override recipe values/times, so compute values from the active state/layout rather than hardcoding.
scenarios: Use seeded scenarios rather than identical resets: train/develop on cramped_room, asymmetric_advantages, and coordination_ring; validate on counter_circuit_o_1order; hold out forced_coordination, counter_circuit, tomato/mixed layouts, controlled-agent index reversal, alternate valid starting positions/orientations, and scripted-partner styles. A seed should control layout selection, valid randomized start state, tie-breaking, partner randomness, and any optional randomized pot/object starts; record the pinned repository commit and layout name. Keep a fixed hidden seed set for evaluation. Exclude forced_coordination from the default GreedyHumanModel baseline because its source warns that the greedy model may not work where unilateral completion is impossible; use an explicit handoff partner for that scenario.
strategy_summary: Treat each accepted soup as a pipelined job: reserve a recipe and pot, fetch ingredients, fill it, explicitly start cooking under modern dynamics, stage a dish, pick up the ready soup, and deliver. Code should own exact state bookkeeping, recipe/value arithmetic, reachability, collision-safe shortest paths, interaction preconditions, timers, and stale-action rejection. Astra should allocate roles, choose among near-equal recipes, set circulation and handoff protocols, and adapt when a layout or partner violates the initial plan. Jev should answer small typed recognition/choice questions over legal code-generated task candidates, such as pot phase, delivery urgency, traffic priority, or handoff status; it should not emit raw directions or do arithmetic. Give ready-soup delivery and traffic recovery priority over speculative ingredient work, and use a custom protocol rather than stock greedy behavior on forced-coordination or mixed-recipe layouts.
risks: Upstream pyproject.toml and uv.lock declare Python 3.10 only, while the evaluator is Python 3.12.3; install the pinned source with an explicit compatibility override and test imports before building the adaptor.
The native OvercookedEnv is synchronous; without an adaptor-owned worker Astra can block the world and accidentally turn the tier-2 design into tier 1.
The one-tick primitive deadline is about 0.166667 seconds, shorter than Jev's approximately 0.5-second response; use asynchronous prefetch/caching and STAY or a safe continuation fallback.
GreedyHumanModel is specialized for a single three-onion order and its source warns it may fail on forced_coordination; mixed recipes need a custom scripted partner.
The official demo's Socket.IO server is optional and adds network/session/tick-queue complexity; it is not needed for the offline symbolic interface.
Commercial Overcooked GUI/mod/emulator automation would require a game installation and display/input stack and may create EULA, platform, anti-cheat, or online ToS risk; it is not selected.
No commercial-game order timers, tips, combos, burning, dish washing, or star thresholds should be assumed; the selected benchmark has its own sparse-reward mechanics.
Stale delayed model decisions can execute after a reset or after a pot/partner state change unless tagged with episode ID and observation timestep.
Pygame/OpenCV rendering can fail on a headless server; use opencv-python-headless, SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy, and symbolic state only.
Collision resolution cancels both movement attempts on a collision or position swap, so naive independent paths can waste ticks or deadlock narrow layouts.
